proposals.evidence: DEDR 1025 gives Tamil oṉpatu/ompatu, Malayalam ompatu, Kannada ombattu/ombhattu, Kodagu oymbadi, Kota orbād, Tulu ormba and Gondi unmā nine. The retained variants preserve this numeral stem; Indo-Aryan nau/no and Telugu-type tommidi responses belong elsewhere. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
